new_questions.title: QS World top US universities (2025)
new_questions.prompt: Name the highest-ranked US universities in the QS World University Rankings 2025 (i.e. lowest QS world rank numbers among US institutions).
new_questions.disclaimer: Ranks reflect global QS World University Rankings 2025 position; only US institutions in the answer pool are included. Some highly ranked US schools (e.g. UCSF) are not in the answer pool and are omitted.
new_questions.trivia: MIT has held QS's global No. 1 spot every year since 2012 — the longest unbroken run at #1 by any university in the rankings' history.

new_questions.title: Times Higher Ed top US universities (2025)
new_questions.prompt: Name the highest-ranked US universities in the Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2025 (lowest world rank numbers among US institutions).
new_questions.disclaimer: Ranks reflect THE World University Rankings 2025 global position; only US institutions in the answer pool are included.
new_questions.trivia: Times Higher Education has ranked either an American university or Oxford at global No. 1 in every edition since it split from QS in 2010.
new_questions.source_name: Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2025

new_questions.title: Shanghai ARWU top US universities (2024)
new_questions.prompt: Name the highest-ranked US universities in the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU/Shanghai) 2024 (lowest world rank numbers among US institutions).
new_questions.disclaimer: Ranks reflect ShanghaiRanking's ARWU 2024 global position; only US institutions in the answer pool are included. ARWU weights Nobel/Fields prizes and research citations heavily.
new_questions.trivia: Harvard has held the No. 1 spot in ARWU every single year since the ranking was first published in 2003.
new_questions.source_name: ShanghaiRanking's Academic Ranking of World Universities 2024

new_questions.title: Highest-ranked California universities (US News 2025)
new_questions.prompt: Name the highest-ranked California universities in the US News Best National Universities ranking 2025 (i.e. lowest US News rank numbers).
new_questions.disclaimer: Ranks are US News 2025 National Universities positions, restricted to California-based institutions in the answer pool. National Liberal Arts Colleges are ranked on a separate list and are not included.
new_questions.trivia: The University of California system alone holds five spots in the US News National top 40 — no other public university system comes close.
new_questions.source_name: US News Best Colleges 2025 — National Universities

new_questions.title: Most claimed CFB national titles among SEC schools
new_questions.prompt: Name the current Southeastern Conference (SEC) member schools that have claimed the most college football national championships in program history.
new_questions.disclaimer: Counts are program-claimed titles (per each school's official record book), including pre-poll era selections. Oklahoma and Texas are counted as SEC members following their 2024 conference move.
new_questions.trivia: Alabama's 18 claimed national titles are more than the next two SEC members combined.
new_questions.source_name: NCAA FBS National Championship claims — Wikipedia (aggregating school record books)

new_questions.title: Highest-ranked ACC universities (US News 2025)
new_questions.prompt: Name the current Atlantic Coast Conference (ACC) member schools with the highest US News Best National Universities rank in 2025 (lowest rank numbers).
new_questions.disclaimer: ACC membership reflects the 2024-25 realignment (California, Stanford, and SMU included). Only ACC members present in the answer pool are listed. Ranks are US News 2025 National Universities positions.
new_questions.trivia: The ACC now spans three US time zones, from Boston College in the East to Cal and Stanford on the Pacific.
new_questions.source_name: US News Best Colleges 2025 — National Universities

new_questions.title: Highest-ranked Big Ten universities (US News 2025)
new_questions.prompt: Name the current Big Ten Conference member schools with the highest US News Best National Universities rank in 2025 (lowest rank numbers).
new_questions.disclaimer: Big Ten membership reflects the 2024-25 realignment (UCLA, USC, Oregon, and Washington included). Only Big Ten members present in the answer pool are listed.
new_questions.trivia: The Big Ten now has 18 members and stretches from Rutgers on the Atlantic to UCLA and USC on the Pacific — the widest geographic span of any US athletic conference.
new_questions.source_name: US News Best Colleges 2025 — National Universities

new_questions.title: Public Ivies by US News rank (2025)
new_questions.prompt: Name the traditionally-cited 'Public Ivy' universities with the highest US News Best National Universities rank in 2025 (lowest rank numbers).
new_questions.disclaimer: The 'Public Ivies' list here follows Richard Moll's 1985 selection plus commonly cited additions (Michigan, UNC, Virginia, William & Mary, UT Austin, Berkeley, UCLA, Wisconsin, Illinois, Washington). Only schools in the answer pool are shown.
new_questions.trivia: Richard Moll, a former Yale admissions officer, coined the term 'Public Ivy' in his 1985 book to identify state universities delivering an 'Ivy League experience at a state school price'.
new_questions.source_name: US News Best Colleges 2025 — National Universities

new_questions.title: 'Little Ivies' by US News LAC rank (2025)
new_questions.prompt: Name the northeastern liberal-arts colleges commonly grouped as the 'Little Ivies' with the highest US News Best National Liberal Arts Colleges rank in 2025 (lowest rank numbers).
new_questions.disclaimer: The 'Little Ivies' informally covers the elite liberal arts colleges of the Northeast — including the NESCAC members plus Vassar, Haverford, and Swarthmore. Only Little-Ivy schools in the answer pool are shown; tie-broken alphabetically.
new_questions.trivia: Williams and Amherst have alternated between the No. 1 and No. 2 US News LAC spots for most of the past two decades.
new_questions.source_name: US News Best Colleges 2025 — National Liberal Arts Colleges
